notes.title: Patch Notes: GPU Selection Fix
notes.notes: Hello! Thank you once again for your patience! I just released a small update. The issue appears to have been related to the laptop not selecting the dedicated graphics card. Please update the game and let me know issue has been resolved.

notes.title: Anoxia Station Devlog Update v.1.0.1 & Steam Deck Compatible
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First of all, I want to thank everyone for playing Anoxia Station. I am thrilled to see that so many of you are already enjoying my little game and discovering the truth underground. Please keep enjoying it and sending your feedback through Steam discussions and reviews. Posting a positive review helps us, small developers, reach new players.

I've been listening to all your feedback and suggestions, and I am releasing a new update. Anoxia Station V.1.0.1 includes several improvements and bug fixes. You can read the complete changelog below:

New Features:

New Scribble version implemented.
Game Maker has been updated to version 2024.13.1.193.

Audio:

Changed the sound at the beginning of Chapter 1.

Localization:

Added missing Chinese characters.
Corrected the 'Hg' index entry, which was incorrectly appearing as an image; this has been fixed for all languages.

UI and Visuals:

Updated credits.
Optimized water shaders in Chapters 4 and 6 for improved performance.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where clathrate could block gate entry in Chapter 5.
Resolved a crash in Chapter 2 related to Al-Kaw.
Fixed an issue that occurred when simultaneously creating a new character card and a building card.
Fixed fire-related bugs affecting all buildings.
Added an extra check for the stats drawing process.
Fixed a softlock in Chapter 3 that prevented the construction of additional Gasbohrungen.
Research points are now refunded when a building is cancelled.
Fixed potential Chapter 4 crashes when playing in Chinese.

I also have good news for Steam Deck users. Valve has tested the performance of Anoxia Station on the portable console and confirmed that it is fully playable. All game functionalities are accessible using the default controls. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089729/acd069e13385ec0d4f167d522070d470a7273ef9.png
The game now displays Steam Deck icons, and the default graphics configuration performs well on the device.

Yakov & Daria
